extracted.intended_audience: GAP users and developers (mathematicians and computational algebra programmers)
extracted.subtask_description: Reference documentation for the properties, operations, and constructors related to general mappings and binary relations in GAP, including definitions (IsTotal, IsInjective, etc.), image/preimage operations, algebra-compatibility predicates, and closure/constructor functions for relations.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsTotal
rubrics_metrics.description: IsTotal(map) is true if each element in the source S of the general mapping map has images, i.e., smap ≠ ∅ for all s ∈ S, and false otherwise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines totality of a general mapping; used as a predicate for whether every source element maps to at least one target.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsSingleValued
rubrics_metrics.description: IsSingleValued(map) is true if each element in the source S of the general mapping map has at most one image, i.e., |smap| ≤ 1 for all s ∈ S, and false otherwise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Equivalently, preimages of different range elements are disjoint. Used to distinguish single-valued mappings from multi-valued relations.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsMapping
rubrics_metrics.description: IsMapping(map) is a filter stating the general mapping map assigns to each element elm of its source a unique element Image(map, elm) of its range.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Equivalently true iff the general mapping is both total and single-valued (see IsTotal, IsSingleValued).

rubrics_metrics.name: IsInjective
rubrics_metrics.description: IsInjective(map) is true if the images of different elements in the source S of map are disjoint, i.e., xmap ∩ ymap = ∅ for x ≠ y ∈ S.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Equivalently true iff each element in the range has at most one preimage in S.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsSurjective
rubrics_metrics.description: IsSurjective(map) is true if each element in the range R of map has preimages in the source S of map, i.e., {s ∈ S | x ∈ smap} ≠ ∅ for all x ∈ R.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines onto-ness of a general mapping with respect to its declared range.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsBijective
rubrics_metrics.description: IsBijective(map) is true for a general mapping map iff it is an injective and surjective mapping.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combines IsMapping (total & single-valued), IsInjective, and IsSurjective.

rubrics_metrics.name: Range
rubrics_metrics.description: Range(map): the range of a general mapping (the declared codomain).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Basic attribute used by many operations; distinct from the image (actual values).

rubrics_metrics.name: Source
rubrics_metrics.description: Source(map): the source (declared domain) of a general mapping.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Basic attribute used by many operations; distinct from the preimage (elements that actually have images).

rubrics_metrics.name: UnderlyingRelation
rubrics_metrics.description: UnderlyingRelation(map) is the domain of pairs (s, r) with s in the source and r in the range of map and r ∈ ImagesElm(map, s).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each element represented by a direct product element; the concrete relation underlying the mapping.

rubrics_metrics.name: UnderlyingGeneralMapping
rubrics_metrics.description: UnderlyingGeneralMapping(map): attribute name referring to the underlying relation/domain of pairs for a general mapping.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to fetch/set the low-level representation of a mapping's relation.

rubrics_metrics.name: ImagesSource
rubrics_metrics.description: ImagesSource(map) is the set of images of the source of the general mapping map (the image as an attribute).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Delegates to ImagesSet; introduced primarily to store the image as an attribute value.

rubrics_metrics.name: ImagesRepresentative
rubrics_metrics.description: ImagesRepresentative(map, elm) returns either a representative of the set of images of elm under map or fail if elm has no images under map.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only valid if elm is in the source; anything may happen if not. Can be used by methods when a single representative is enough.

rubrics_metrics.name: ImagesElm
rubrics_metrics.description: ImagesElm(map, elm) returns the set of all images of elm under map (if elm is in the source).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Basic operation for enumerating images of a single source element; calling with non-source element may have arbitrary behavior.

rubrics_metrics.name: ImagesSet
rubrics_metrics.description: ImagesSet(map, elms) returns the set of all images of elms (a subset of the source) under map.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: elms must be a subset of the source; result may be a proper set or a domain. Calling with invalid elms may produce arbitrary results.

rubrics_metrics.name: ImageElm
rubrics_metrics.description: ImageElm(map, elm) returns the unique image of elm when map is total and single-valued (i.e., a mapping).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only valid if map is total and single-valued and elm is in the source; otherwise behavior is unspecified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Image (Image variants)
rubrics_metrics.description: Image(map) / Image(map, elm) / Image(map, coll): functions returning the image of the mapping, the unique image of elm (when map is total and single-valued), or the image of a subset coll of the source.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Image(map) delegates to ImagesSource; Image(map, elm) delegates to ImageElm; Image(map, coll) delegates to ImagesSet. Image(map, elm) requires a total single-valued mapping; Image(map, coll) may accept multi-valued mappings. Composition notation caveat: composition in GAP follows right-action convention so (map1 * map2)(x) ≡ map2(map1(x)). If the second argument is not in the source/subset of the source, an error is signalled.

rubrics_metrics.name: Images (Images variants)
rubrics_metrics.description: Images(map) / Images(map, elm) / Images(map, coll): functions returning the image of a general mapping (possibly multi-valued), the set of images of an element elm, or the set of images of a subset coll.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Delegates to ImagesSource, ImagesElm, or ImagesSet respectively. If second arg not valid, an error is signalled. Positions/ordering in list-to-list images need not correspond.

rubrics_metrics.name: PreImagesRange
rubrics_metrics.description: PreImagesRange(map) is the set of preimages of the range of the general mapping map (stored as attribute).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Delegates to PreImagesSet; introduced to store preimage as attribute value.

rubrics_metrics.name: PreImagesElm
rubrics_metrics.description: PreImagesElm(map, elm) returns the set of all preimages of elm under map if elm is an element of the range.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Anything may happen if elm is not in the range; basic operation for enumerating preimages.

rubrics_metrics.name: PreImageElm
rubrics_metrics.description: PreImageElm(map, elm) returns the unique preimage of elm when map is injective and surjective (i.e., bijective mapping).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only valid for injective & surjective mappings and when elm is in the range; otherwise unspecified.

rubrics_metrics.name: PreImagesRepresentative
rubrics_metrics.description: PreImagesRepresentative(map, elm) returns either a representative of the set of preimages of elm under map or fail iff elm has no preimages under map.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only defined for elm in the range; may be used as a cheaper alternative when a single representative suffices.

rubrics_metrics.name: PreImagesSet
rubrics_metrics.description: PreImagesSet(map, elms) returns the set of all preimages of elms (a subset of the range) under map.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: elms must be a subset of the range; result may be a proper set or domain. Behavior for invalid elms is unspecified.

rubrics_metrics.name: PreImage (PreImage variants)
rubrics_metrics.description: PreImage(map) / PreImage(map, elm) / PreImage(map, coll): functions returning the preimage of map (elements of source which have values), the unique preimage of elm when map is injective & surjective, or the preimage of a subset coll of the range.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PreImage(map) delegates to PreImagesRange; PreImage(map, elm) delegates to PreImageElm; PreImage(map, coll) delegates to PreImagesSet. If the second argument is not an element or subset of the range, an error is signalled. Note: PreImage(map, coll) may be used when map is non-injective/non-surjective.

rubrics_metrics.name: PreImages (PreImages variants)
rubrics_metrics.description: PreImages(map) / PreImages(map, elm) / PreImages(map, coll): functions returning the set of source elements that have images, the set of preimages of elm, or the set of preimages of coll.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Delegates to PreImagesRange, PreImagesElm, or PreImagesSet respectively. If second arg not valid, an error is signalled.

rubrics_metrics.name: Arithmetic operations on general mappings
rubrics_metrics.description: General mappings are arithmetic objects: pointwise sum (for mappings with same source/range/preimage/image), scalar multiplication, and product defined as composition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sum: images at a point are all sums of elements from each mapping's images. Composition is associative; CompositionMapping composes in reversed order. One(map) returns fail if source and range differ, else identity mapping of source. Inverse(map) returns fail for non-bijective or differing source/range; otherwise returns inverse mapping. InverseGeneralMapping attribute gives underlying-relation-based inverse (swapping pairs). Methods for InverseGeneralMapping should be installed separately; one must not delegate InverseGeneralMapping to Inverse.

rubrics_metrics.name: One behaviour for general mappings
rubrics_metrics.description: One(map) returns fail for a general mapping whose source and range differ; otherwise returns the identity mapping of the source.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note source may differ from preimage; used to define multiplicative identity where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inverse behaviour for general mappings
rubrics_metrics.description: Inverse(map) returns fail when called for a non-bijective general mapping or for a mapping whose source and range differ; otherwise returns the inverse mapping (usual multiplicative inverse).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: InverseGeneralMapping is a related attribute that constructs the inverse underlying-relation even when mapping isn't bijective in the usual sense.

rubrics_metrics.name: InverseGeneralMapping
rubrics_metrics.description: InverseGeneralMapping(F) for general mapping F with source S, range R, and underlying relation Rel returns a general mapping with source R, range S, and underlying relation {(r,s) | (s,r) ∈ Rel}.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May differ from Inverse(map) for non-bijective mappings; methods computing inverse of general mappings should be installed for this attribute. InverseGeneralMapping must not delegate to Inverse, but a known value of Inverse may be fetched.

rubrics_metrics.name: Structure-compatibility types (overview)
rubrics_metrics.description: GAP supports mappings that are compatible with algebraic structures: (1) respect multiplication, (2) respect addition, (3) respect scalar multiplication, (4) respect both multiplicative and additive structure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These distinctions are orthogonal to other categories (e.g., IsSPGeneralMapping) and are used to classify homomorphisms for magmas, groups, rings, modules, algebras, etc.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsMagmaHomomorphism
rubrics_metrics.description: IsMagmaHomomorphism(mapp) is a filter: a magma homomorphism is a total single-valued mapping which respects multiplication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines magma homomorphisms; related constructors exist to create homomorphisms with or without checks.

rubrics_metrics.name: MagmaHomomorphismByFunctionNC
rubrics_metrics.description: MagmaHomomorphismByFunctionNC(G, H, fn) creates the homomorphism from G to H without checking that fn is a homomorphism.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Non-checking constructor for efficiency when the user guarantees correctness.

rubrics_metrics.name: NaturalHomomorphismByGenerators
rubrics_metrics.description: NaturalHomomorphismByGenerators(f, s) returns a mapping from magma f with n generators to magma s with n generators mapping the i-th generator of f to the i-th generator of s.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Constructs canonical homomorphisms between finitely generated objects by generator correspondence.

rubrics_metrics.name: RespectsMultiplication
rubrics_metrics.description: RespectsMultiplication(mapp) returns true if S and R are magmas and (s1, r1), (s2, r2) ∈ underlying relation implies (s1 * s2, r1 * r2) ∈ relation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If mapp is single-valued, equivalent to s1^mapp * s2^mapp = (s1 * s2)^mapp for all s1, s2 ∈ S.

rubrics_metrics.name: RespectsOne
rubrics_metrics.description: RespectsOne(mapp) returns true if S and R are magmas-with-one and (One(S), One(R)) ∈ underlying relation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If single-valued, equivalent to One(S)^mapp = One(R).

rubrics_metrics.name: RespectsInverses
rubrics_metrics.description: RespectsInverses(mapp) returns true if S and R are magmas-with-inverses such that (s, r) ∈ relation implies (s^{-1}, r^{-1}) ∈ relation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If single-valued, equivalent to Inverse(s)^mapp = Inverse(s^mapp) for all s ∈ S.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsGroupGeneralMapping / IsGroupHomomorphism
rubrics_metrics.description: IsGroupGeneralMapping(mapp) (and IsGroupHomomorphism as a synonym when total & single-valued) specifies that a mapping respects multiplication and inverses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See group homomorphism chapter for more details; IsGroupHomomorphism is the meet of IsGroupGeneralMapping and IsMapping.

rubrics_metrics.name: KernelOfMultiplicativeGeneralMapping
rubrics_metrics.description: KernelOfMultiplicativeGeneralMapping(mapp) returns the set of all elements in the source of mapp that have the identity of the range in their set of images.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This set is a monoid if mapp respects multiplication and one, and if the source is associative.

rubrics_metrics.name: CoKernelOfMultiplicativeGeneralMapping
rubrics_metrics.description: CoKernelOfMultiplicativeGeneralMapping(mapp) returns the set of all elements in the range that have the identity of the source in their set of preimages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a monoid if mapp respects multiplication and one, and range is associative.

rubrics_metrics.name: RespectsAddition
rubrics_metrics.description: RespectsAddition(mapp) returns true if S and R are additive magmas such that (s1, r1), (s2, r2) ∈ relation implies (s1 + s2, r1 + r2) ∈ relation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If single-valued, equivalent to s1^mapp + s2^mapp = (s1 + s2)^mapp for all s1, s2 ∈ S.

rubrics_metrics.name: RespectsAdditiveInverses
rubrics_metrics.description: RespectsAdditiveInverses(mapp) returns true if S and R are additive-magmas-with-inverses such that (s, r) ∈ relation implies (−s, −r) ∈ relation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If single-valued, equivalent to AdditiveInverse(s)^mapp = AdditiveInverse(s^mapp) for all s ∈ S.

rubrics_metrics.name: RespectsZero
rubrics_metrics.description: RespectsZero(mapp) returns true if S and R are additive-magmas-with-zero such that (Zero(S), Zero(R)) ∈ relation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If single-valued, equivalent to Zero(S)^mapp = Zero(R).

rubrics_metrics.name: IsAdditiveGroupGeneralMapping / IsAdditiveGroupHomomorphism
rubrics_metrics.description: IsAdditiveGroupGeneralMapping specifies whether mapp respects addition and additive inverses. IsAdditiveGroupHomomorphism is the meet with IsMapping.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides the additive-group homomorphism classification when combined with mapping property.

rubrics_metrics.name: KernelOfAdditiveGeneralMapping
rubrics_metrics.description: KernelOfAdditiveGeneralMapping(mapp) returns the set of all elements in the source whose images contain the zero of the range.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Analogous to multiplicative kernel, specialized to additive structure.

rubrics_metrics.name: CoKernelOfAdditiveGeneralMapping
rubrics_metrics.description: CoKernelOfAdditiveGeneralMapping(mapp) returns the set of elements in the range that have the zero of the source in their preimages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Analogous to multiplicative cokernel, specialized to additive structure.

rubrics_metrics.name: RespectsScalarMultiplication
rubrics_metrics.description: RespectsScalarMultiplication(mapp) returns true if S and R are left modules over the same acting domain D (with D of S contained in D of R) and (s, r) ∈ relation implies (c * s, c * r) ∈ relation for all c ∈ D.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If single-valued, equivalent to c * (s^mapp) = (c * s)^mapp for all c ∈ D, s ∈ S.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsLeftModuleGeneralMapping / IsLeftModuleHomomorphism
rubrics_metrics.description: IsLeftModuleGeneralMapping specifies whether mapp satisfies IsAdditiveGroupGeneralMapping and RespectsScalarMultiplication. IsLeftModuleHomomorphism is the meet with IsMapping.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to classify module homomorphisms (left modules) in GAP.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsLinearMapping
rubrics_metrics.description: IsLinearMapping(F, mapp) returns true if mapp is F-linear: source and range are vector spaces over same division ring D and f(a+b)=f(a)+f(b), f(s*a)=s*f(a) for all a,b in source and s ∈ D.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operation to detect vector-space homomorphisms (linear maps).

rubrics_metrics.name: IsRingGeneralMapping / IsRingHomomorphism
rubrics_metrics.description: IsRingGeneralMapping specifies whether a general mapping respects addition and multiplication (IsAdditiveGroupGeneralMapping and RespectsMultiplication). IsRingHomomorphism is the meet with IsMapping.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Classifies ring homomorphisms; other variants exist for rings with one, algebras, fields.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsRingWithOneGeneralMapping / IsRingWithOneHomomorphism
rubrics_metrics.description: IsRingWithOneGeneralMapping and its homomorphism synonym classify mappings that respect ring structure including multiplicative identity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combines ring homomorphism requirements with RespectsOne.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsAlgebraGeneralMapping / IsAlgebraHomomorphism
rubrics_metrics.description: IsAlgebraGeneralMapping specifies whether a mapping satisfies IsRingGeneralMapping and IsLeftModuleGeneralMapping (compatibility with algebra structure). IsAlgebraHomomorphism is the meet with IsMapping.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to classify algebra homomorphisms (rings with module structure).

rubrics_metrics.name: IsAlgebraWithOneGeneralMapping / IsAlgebraWithOneHomomorphism
rubrics_metrics.description: IsAlgebraWithOneGeneralMapping specifies IsAlgebraGeneralMapping plus RespectsOne. The homomorphism variant is the meet with IsMapping.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Classifies unital algebra homomorphisms.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsFieldHomomorphism
rubrics_metrics.description: IsFieldHomomorphism(mapp) is true iff the general mapping is a ring homomorphism with source a field.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specialized predicate for field homomorphisms.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsGeneralMapping
rubrics_metrics.description: IsGeneralMapping(map) is the category membership predicate indicating the object is a general mapping.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implies IsMultiplicativeElementWithInverse and IsAssociativeElement and is defined as the disjoint union of IsNonSPGeneralMapping and IsSPGeneralMapping.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsConstantTimeAccessGeneralMapping
rubrics_metrics.description: IsConstantTimeAccessGeneralMapping(map) is true if the underlying relation of map knows its AsList value, allowing use of that list for ImagesElm calls, and false otherwise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates mappings that can provide constant-time access to image lists via stored AsList; acquiring this property changes which methods can be used.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsEndoGeneralMapping
rubrics_metrics.description: IsEndoGeneralMapping(obj) is true if a general mapping has equal source and range (endomapping).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to identify endomorphisms and relations considered as endo-mappings (e.g., binary relations on X).

rubrics_metrics.name: Basic vs Secondary operations rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Distinction between basic and secondary operations for general mappings: each mapping must be in one of two categories (IsNonSPGeneralMapping or IsSPGeneralMapping), and method/operation delegation rules depend on this.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For one category, ImagesElm and PreImagesElm are basic operations; for the other, representative/kernal/cokernel operations are basic and ImagesElm/PreImagesElm may delegate to them. Secondary operations include IsInjective, IsSingleValued, IsSurjective, IsTotal; they may use basic operations but must not be used by them. Methods for operations ImagesElm, ImagesRepresentative, ImagesSet, ImageElm, PreImagesElm, PreImagesRepresentative, PreImagesSet, PreImageElm take (map, elm) and must not check elm lies in source/range — they may return fail or arbitrary objects; argument checks are centralized in Image/Images/PreImage/PreImages functions which delegate to these operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsSPGeneralMapping / IsNonSPGeneralMapping
rubrics_metrics.description: IsSPGeneralMapping(map) and IsNonSPGeneralMapping(map) classify the two disjoint categories of general mappings (structure-preserving vs non-structure-preserving families).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used internally to choose which operations are considered basic and how delegation should occur.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsGeneralMappingFamily
rubrics_metrics.description: IsGeneralMappingFamily(obj) is the family category for the family of general mappings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Meta-level category used to group families of mappings with common source/range families.

rubrics_metrics.name: FamilyRange
rubrics_metrics.description: FamilyRange(Fam) is the elements family of the family of the range of each general mapping in the family Fam.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attribute for families of mappings to describe ranges collectively.

rubrics_metrics.name: FamilySource
rubrics_metrics.description: FamilySource(Fam) is the elements family of the family of the source of each general mapping in the family Fam.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attribute for families of mappings to describe sources collectively.

rubrics_metrics.name: FamiliesOfGeneralMappingsAndRanges
rubrics_metrics.description: FamiliesOfGeneralMappingsAndRanges(Fam) is a list storing at odd positions families of general mappings with source in Fam and at even positions families of ranges of those general mappings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data-structure to record family relationships between mappings and their sources/ranges.

rubrics_metrics.name: GeneralMappingsFamily
rubrics_metrics.description: GeneralMappingsFamily(sourcefam, rangefam) is the family containing all general mappings with the same source family FS and same range family FR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Constructs the family (domain) of mappings sharing given source/range families.

rubrics_metrics.name: TypeOfDefaultGeneralMapping
rubrics_metrics.description: TypeOfDefaultGeneralMapping(source, range, filter) returns the type of mappings with IsDefaultGeneralMappingRep with given source, range, and additional categories filter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to decide default domain/type for general mappings given constraints.

rubrics_metrics.name: Relations as general mappings
rubrics_metrics.description: Binary relations are conceptually represented as general mappings from X to itself; IsBinaryRelation is a synonym for IsEndoGeneralMapping.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allows reuse of mapping machinery for relations (e.g., graph algorithms, connectivity methods).

rubrics_metrics.name: IsBinaryRelation
rubrics_metrics.description: IsBinaryRelation(R) is exactly the same category as IsEndoGeneralMapping (relation on X represented as general mapping X->X).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Predicate to identify binary relations in GAP.

rubrics_metrics.name: BinaryRelationByElements
rubrics_metrics.description: BinaryRelationByElements(domain, elms) constructs the binary relation on domain with underlying relation consisting of the tuples collection elms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Similar to GeneralMappingByElements but with source=range; use to create relations from explicit pair lists.

rubrics_metrics.name: IdentityBinaryRelation
rubrics_metrics.description: IdentityBinaryRelation(degree) / IdentityBinaryRelation(domain) returns the diagonal relation (x,x) pairs; with integer degree uses domain {1..degree}.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returns IdentityMapping when domain is a GAP object like a group; example outputs shown in manual.

rubrics_metrics.name: EmptyBinaryRelation
rubrics_metrics.description: EmptyBinaryRelation(degree) / EmptyBinaryRelation(domain) returns the empty relation on the given domain (or points {1..degree}).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful constructor for relations with no pairs; example equates to BinaryRelationOnPoints with empty adjacency lists.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsReflexiveBinaryRelation
rubrics_metrics.description: IsReflexiveBinaryRelation(R) returns true if relation R is reflexive: for all x ∈ X, (x,x) ∈ R (equivalently x ∈ R(x)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A reflexive binary relation is necessarily a total endomorphic mapping (IsTotal). Examples in manual illustrate true/false cases.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsSymmetricBinaryRelation
rubrics_metrics.description: IsSymmetricBinaryRelation(R) returns true if R is symmetric: (x,y) ∈ R implies (y,x) ∈ R (equivalently preimage set of x equals image set R(x)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples provided show symmetric/non-symmetric cases.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsTransitiveBinaryRelation
rubrics_metrics.description: IsTransitiveBinaryRelation(R) returns true if R is transitive: (x,y),(y,z) ∈ R implies (x,z) ∈ R (equivalently R(R(x)) ⊆ R(x) for all x).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples provided; TransitiveClosureBinaryRelation is related operation that enforces transitivity.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsAntisymmetricBinaryRelation
rubrics_metrics.description: IsAntisymmetricBinaryRelation(rel) returns true if rel is antisymmetric: (x,y),(y,x) ∈ rel implies x = y (equivalently preimage(x) ∩ R(x) = {x}).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to test antisymmetry when classifying partial orders.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsPreOrderBinaryRelation
rubrics_metrics.description: IsPreOrderBinaryRelation(rel) returns true if rel is a preorder (i.e., reflexive and transitive).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Convenience predicate for preorder detection.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsPartialOrderBinaryRelation
rubrics_metrics.description: IsPartialOrderBinaryRelation(rel) returns true if rel is a partial order (a preorder that is also antisymmetric).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to detect partial orders; HasseDiagram operations relate to this.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsHasseDiagram
rubrics_metrics.description: IsHasseDiagram(rel) returns true if rel is a Hasse Diagram of a partial order (i.e., was computed via HasseDiagramBinaryRelation).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifier for relations specifically representing Hasse diagrams.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsEquivalenceRelation
rubrics_metrics.description: IsEquivalenceRelation(R) returns true if R is symmetric, transitive, and reflexive (an equivalence relation).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Equivalence relations correspond to partitions of the underlying set.

rubrics_metrics.name: Successors
rubrics_metrics.description: Successors(R) returns the list of images of a binary relation R as adjacency lists ordered by the sorted underlying set; errors if domain is not {1..n}.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adjacency-list representation of relation; illustrated with an example.

rubrics_metrics.name: DegreeOfBinaryRelation
rubrics_metrics.description: DegreeOfBinaryRelation(R) returns the size of the underlying domain of R (natural for relations on points).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: returns 3 for a relation on 3 points.

rubrics_metrics.name: PartialOrderOfHasseDiagram
rubrics_metrics.description: PartialOrderOfHasseDiagram(HD) returns the partial order associated with Hasse Diagram HD (generated by reflexive and transitive closure).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Converts a Hasse diagram into its full partial order.

rubrics_metrics.name: BinaryRelationOnPoints
rubrics_metrics.description: BinaryRelationOnPoints(list) / BinaryRelationOnPointsNC(list): constructs a binary relation on points {1..n} given a list of n lists with elements in {1..n}. NC version skips validation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Index i is related to entries of list[i]. Use the NC version for speed when input is guaranteed valid.

rubrics_metrics.name: RandomBinaryRelationOnPoints
rubrics_metrics.description: RandomBinaryRelationOnPoints(degree) creates a random relation on points of given degree.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Constructor for stochastic testing/examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: AsBinaryRelationOnPoints
rubrics_metrics.description: AsBinaryRelationOnPoints(trans) / (perm) / (rel) returns the relation on points represented by a transformation, permutation, or relation; if rel already on points it is returned.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Converts transformations/permutations/general relations into a relation-on-points representation; examples show equivalences.

rubrics_metrics.name: ReflexiveClosureBinaryRelation
rubrics_metrics.description: ReflexiveClosureBinaryRelation(R) returns the smallest relation containing R that is reflexive (inherit symmetric/transitive properties of R).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to add reflexive pairs minimally; closure inherits other properties when appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: SymmetricClosureBinaryRelation
rubrics_metrics.description: SymmetricClosureBinaryRelation(R) returns the smallest relation containing R that is symmetric (inherits reflexive/transitive properties of R).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to symmetrize relations minimally.

rubrics_metrics.name: TransitiveClosureBinaryRelation
rubrics_metrics.description: TransitiveClosureBinaryRelation(rel) returns the smallest transitive relation containing rel (modified Floyd–Warshall algorithm; O(n^3) runtime).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Computes transitive closure using an ordering of vertices; asymptotic runtime O(n^3).

rubrics_metrics.name: HasseDiagramBinaryRelation
rubrics_metrics.description: HasseDiagramBinaryRelation(partial-order) returns the minimal relation contained in the partial order whose reflexive and transitive closure equals the partial order (the Hasse diagram).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to compute Hasse diagram representation from a partial order.

rubrics_metrics.name: StronglyConnectedComponents
rubrics_metrics.description: StronglyConnectedComponents(R) returns an equivalence relation on vertices of binary relation R corresponding to its strongly connected components.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Graph-theoretic SCC decomposition for relations viewed as directed graphs.

rubrics_metrics.name: PartialOrderByOrderingFunction
rubrics_metrics.description: PartialOrderByOrderingFunction(dom, orderfunc) constructs a partial order on domain dom using binary ordering function orderfunc; returns fail if orderfunc does not describe a partial order.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Builds partial orders from a comparator function; orderfunc must be reflexive/transitive/antisymmetric to succeed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equivalence relation ↔ partition correspondence
rubrics_metrics.description: An equivalence relation on X is reflexive, symmetric, transitive; it induces a partition P of X where elements related are in the same block; partitions correspond to equivalence relations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Conceptual note connecting relations to partitions; used when reasoning about equivalence relations and partition-based algorithms.
